reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown harmonize Michal's childlessness in 2 Samuel 6:23 with the five sons of 21:8 by reading them as her sister Merab's sons, whom Michal adopted.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible takes the text at face value, noting 2 Samuel 6:23 declares Michal childless while 21:8 names five sons born to her.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
sides.verseText: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

sides.snippet: the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite
sides.verseText: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
